"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

import rosterkit.errors


# ---
def contact_rows(students):
    """Text rows sorted by name with display name, section and email in columns."""
    if not students:
        raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError("no students to list")
    # every student needs an email on the sheet
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    name_width = 0
    section_width = 0
    # measure the columns
    for student in ordered:
        name_width = max(name_width, len(student.display_name))
        section_width = max(section_width, len(student.section))
    rows = []
    # lay out one row per student
    for student in ordered:
        rows.append(
            f"{student.display_name:<{name_width}}  "
            f"{student.section:<{section_width}}  {student.email}"
        )
    return rows
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import rosterkit.models
import rosterkit.errors
import rosterkit.contacts


def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    return rosterkit.models.Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(
            [
                make_student("Young", "Al", "10A", "al@x.org"),
                make_student("Abel", "Bo", "9", "bo@x.org"),
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(rows, ["Abel, Bo   9    bo@x.org", "Young, Al  10A  al@x.org"])

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        students = [make_student("Abel", "Bo", "9", None)]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError, "Abel, Bo"):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(students)

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([])
EOF
